events.event_name: SER Pop Up at The Canvas SoHo: Custom Hats from Medellín
events.address: The Canvas SoHo, 456 W Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up for Colombian hat brand SER with a customization bar, live DJ set, drinks and the opportunity to meet the team.
events.what_is_free: Admission/registration is free. The event advertises drinks and a DJ set; hats and customization are retail offerings unless the host states otherwise on site.
events.caveats: The host page asks guests to RSVP but does not state host approval, a waitlist, or a paid ticket requirement. Retail merchandise is not free.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 13 and Sunday, September 14 from 12–7 PM at The Canvas SoHo, 456 W Broadway. Use the Luma page to register.

events.event_name: DISCOVER SHIYENZE | Fashion Week Open Atelier
events.what_it_is: A three-day open atelier during NYFW with designer Roselyne Shiyenze, signature and one-of-one pieces, try-ons, direct shopping and conversation around Kenyan heritage and craftsmanship.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free with RSVP. Shopping is optional; merchandise is for sale.
events.caveats: Eventbrite explicitly says free with RSVP. No organizer-selection or approval step is stated.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11, 5–9 PM; Saturday September 12, 12–8 PM; Sunday September 13, 12–6 PM. The September 13 occurrence remains actionable until 6 PM.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza, 9th Ave between 14th and 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand-style launch activation for Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product discovery, snacks, refreshments, samples and scratch-off giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary refreshments, croissants and a Face Base+ sample are advertised while supplies last; the first 100 guests are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample. Scratch-off prizes are chance-based.
events.caveats: Giveaways, samples, refreshments and croissants are while supplies last. The Eventbrite listing is organized by Bobbi Brown Cosmetics and does not state an approval step.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza. Use the Bobbi Brown Eventbrite listing for the current registration path.
